clue.text: Hard and fast frame for native American

indicators.note: the fast word surrounds the hard letter like a frame around a picture

parts.note: apace means quickly, at a fast speed
H is the standard abbreviation for hard, as on pencils

explanation.surface: A rigid, quick-to-build frame made for a Native American.
explanation.definitionFit: The Apache are a Native American people of the south-western United States.

clue.text: Left drink

definitions.meaning: the nautical term for the left-hand side of a ship

explanation.definitionFit: On a ship the left side is the port side, and port is also a fortified wine.

clue.text: Church in woodwork, no place for 5 down 21

parts.note: split as wood plus work: ASH is a wood and OP (opus) is a work

explanation.surface: A church set in carved woodwork, which is no place for a charging animal.
explanation.walkthrough: '5 down 21' means part one of 5 down, BULL (21/22 is PARTI PRIS, read as 'part I'). A bull in a china shop is the proverbial picture of clumsy havoc.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'like a bull in a china shop' marks that kind of store as the last place a bull belongs.

clue.text: Continental origin loved by 5 down 21

definitions.meaning: the mythical princess who gave her name to the continent of Europe
in Greek myth Zeus took the form of a bull to carry her off

explanation.walkthrough: '5 down 21' is part one of 5 down, which is BULL.
explanation.definitionFit: The continent Europe is named after the Phoenician princess Europa, whom Zeus, disguised as a bull, abducted.

clue.text: Not too painful to live on farmland?

parts.note: to be is to exist or live
arable describes land fit for ploughing and crops

explanation.surface: Wondering whether life on a farm would be tolerable.
explanation.walkthrough: The question mark admits that ARABLE is an adjective describing farmland rather than the noun itself.
explanation.definitionFit: Something bearable can be endured, so it is not too painful to put up with.

clue.text: Protection for love, but spelt wrong

indicators.note: the letters of the preceding four words are set down in the wrong order

explanation.surface: A protective charm for a lover, though its spelling is mistaken.
explanation.definitionFit: A bulletproof vest is body armour worn as protection against gunfire.

clue.text: In addition to preceding can be expected

definitions.meaning: a phrase meaning besides or on top of
these words, placed in front of 'can be expected', complete the stock phrase about coping reasonably

explanation.walkthrough: The second half works by completion: put the answer before 'can be expected' and you get the familiar 'as well as can be expected'.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase 'as well as' is a standard way of saying besides or in addition to.

clue.text: Opposition that dialectically are not singularly are

parts.note: an't is an old dialect contraction for are not
is is the singular form of the verb whose plural is are

explanation.surface: A grammarian puzzling over dialect forms of the verb 'to be'.
explanation.definitionFit: Antis are people against something, collectively the opposition.

clue.text: Fatty, female, eaten by sort of 5 across 21 under chimney, died

indicators.note: in a down answer, a piece under another comes after it

parts.note: lum is a Scottish and northern English word for a chimney

indicators.note: the female letter is swallowed inside the bear word

parts.note: 5 across part one is BEAR, and a polar bear is one sort
D is the abbreviation for died, as in genealogies

explanation.surface: A grim story of a woman eaten by a polar bear beneath a chimney.
explanation.walkthrough: '5 across 21' is part one of 5 across, BEAR. 'Fatty' is an insulting name for a fat person.
explanation.definitionFit: Calling someone a lump of lard is a rude way of saying they are fat, exactly like the insult fatty.

clue.text: Relative to judge taking part before river enters sea

indicators.note: the part-and-river pair goes into the sea word

parts.note: the Aral Sea in Central Asia
a bit is a part or piece

explanation.surface: A judicial matter involving a river flowing into the sea.
explanation.definitionFit: Arbitral means relating to an arbiter or arbitration, so to someone who judges a dispute.

clue.text: Please wait after 5 across 21: do you follow?

definitions.meaning: placed after BEAR, part one of 5 across, it forms the request to be patient
asking whether someone is keeping up with your explanation

explanation.walkthrough: '5 across 21' is BEAR, part one of 5 across: 'bear with me' means please wait.
explanation.definitionFit: Asking 'with me?' checks whether a listener is following the argument, as 'do you follow?' does.

clue.text: Pupil, one kept by employer's order, has time for you to be 10 in

definitions.text: time for you to be 10 in

parts.note: the pupil of the eye is called the apple of the eye

indicators.note: the single letter is held inside the employer word

parts.note: a boss is an employer
one more pupil, a learner, abbreviated L as on learner plates
OM is the Order of Merit, a British honour

explanation.surface: A pupil taken on by an employer is given time to settle in.
explanation.walkthrough: 10 is WITH ME: the old song goes 'I'll be with you in apple blossom time', so the answer is the time for you to be with me in.
explanation.definitionFit: The song promises to be with the beloved in apple blossom time, so the phrase names that season.

clue.text: Voice to achieve the female in unison?

to get something is to achieve it
her is the female pronoun

explanation.surface: A choir director hoping a singer will manage to bring the woman into harmony.
explanation.definitionFit: Altogether can mean all at once together, which is what doing something in unison is.

clue.text: Amidst this tumult Kubla heard a lot of rubbish

indicators.note: the answer sits in the middle of the words that follow

explanation.surface: A twist on Coleridge's Kubla Khan, where amid the tumult Kubla heard ancestral voices, here only nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Blah is idle chatter or empty talk, that is a lot of nonsense.

clue.text: Softhearted patrol leader gets a message

parts.note: PL is the Scouting abbreviation for patrol leader
a cable is a telegram

explanation.surface: A gentle-natured Scout patrol leader receives a telegram.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone placable is easily calmed or appeased, so mild and softhearted.

clue.text: In foreign parts Mr Turk goes the way of the Beatles

indicators.note: the Turkish title goes inside the foreign-parts word

parts.note: abroad means in foreign countries
bey is a Turkish title of respect, roughly Mr

explanation.surface: A Turkish gentleman travelling overseas follows the Beatles' path.
explanation.definitionFit: Abbey Road is the London street of the Beatles' studio and the title of their album.

clue.text: A papal 5 down 21 losing a 5 across 21 ward star

parts.note: RC, Roman Catholic, describes the papal church

indicators.note: the bull word drops its letter a

parts.note: part one of 5 down is BULL, and Taurus is the bull of the zodiac
taken as written

explanation.surface: A papal bull missing a word, about a star that guards the bear.

explanation.definitionFit: Arcturus, a bright star, takes its name from Greek words for bear-guard, as it follows the Great Bear.

clue.text: Mistake in detail — oriental tyrant in Cornish village

explanation.walkthrough: POLPOT de-tailed is POLPO. Polperro is a fishing village in Cornwall, the south-western tip of England.
explanation.definitionFit: Polperro is a picturesque harbour village on the south coast of Cornwall.

clue.text: Home for 5 down 21 sounds like that rather than 5 across 21

explanation.walkthrough: '5 down 21' is BULL and '5 across 21' is BEAR, the optimist and pessimist of the stock market.
explanation.definitionFit: A byre is a cowshed, a shelter for cattle including a bull.

clue.text: Descant sung by star?

clue.text: In malicious old style, never mind 12
